cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

mechanism: A keeps its former pupil in a fact-checking exercise until the missing hour is explained, removing transport as an escape.
confusable: Not generic interrogation: the old answer-completeness standard and partial-credit corrections structure A insistence.
comparison: Private missed-hour explanation versus jointly consequential wedding date change.
seedUse: D122 receipt/five/six/last bus/drive; S05 correction of incomplete answers.
